approach.text: A small mole bumbles out of a side tunnel, blinking in the dim light. He's clutching a clay vial and muttering to himself. 'This is... the east passage? Or west? I came from... oh dear.' He nearly walks into you, then looks up. 'Oh! You're not a guard. Can you help me? I just want to go home. I'll sell you this brew — good for the blood, I swear it. Seven coins. I just need the passage toll.'

choices.text: Pay 7 coins for the Mole's Vitality Brew.
Try to snatch the vial while he's distracted.

sold.text: He brightens instantly. 'Oh thank you, thank you!' He presses the vial into your hands and shuffles off down a wrong tunnel, humming contentedly.

caught.text: Your hand darts out — but the mole snaps back with surprising speed, clutching the vial to his chest. His cloudy eyes go sharp. 'A thief! I may be lost, but I am NOT helpless!' He drops into a fighting stance, vial safely tucked away.
